verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with its ROCm software stack, not a hosted service that collects user data. Opting out of having your data used for model training is a policy axis for SaaS and AI services, so the question is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD ingesting customer data that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
